scripts.migrate: echo 'Direct DB migration is removed; run bun run install:supacloud so SupaCloud Management API applies hosted migrations.' && exit 1
scripts.dev:server: echo 'dev:server is removed; SupAuth must run as a SupaCloud Function. Use bun run dev:function.' && exit 1
scripts.check:artifact: bun run build && bun run verify:artifact
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter '@supauth/authorization-core' build && bun run --filter '@supauth/authorization-postgres' build && bun run --filter '@supauth/authorization-conformance' build && bun run --filter '@supauth/shared' build && bun run --filter '@supauth/sdk-typescript' build && bun run --filter '@supauth/sdk-auth-ui' build && bun run --filter '@supauth/auth-server' typecheck
scripts.test: bun run --filter '@supauth/authorization-core' test && bun run --filter '@supauth/authorization-postgres' test && bun run --filter '@supauth/authorization-conformance' test && bun run --filter '@supauth/shared' test && bun run --filter '@supauth/sdk-typescript' test && bun run --filter '@supauth/sdk-auth-ui' test && bun run --filter '@supauth/auth-server' test && bun run --filter '@supauth/admin-console' test && bun run test:contracts && bun run test:tooling
scripts.typecheck:contracts: bun run --filter '@supauth/authorization-core' typecheck && bun run --filter '@supauth/authorization-postgres' typecheck && bun run --filter '@supauth/authorization-conformance' typecheck && bun run --filter '@supauth/shared' typecheck && bun run --filter '@supauth/sdk-typescript' typecheck && bun run --filter '@supauth/sdk-typescript' typecheck:contracts && bun run --filter '@supauth/sdk-auth-ui' typecheck
scripts.check:type-safety: bun run typecheck && bun run typecheck:contracts && bun run typecheck:tooling && bun run --filter '@supauth/admin-console' typecheck && bun run check:contract-coverage && bun run check:static-safety && bun run check:inferred-safety
scripts.check: bun run check:type-safety && bun run test && bun run check:openapi-additive && bun run --filter '@supauth/admin-console' check && bun run --filter '@supauth/admin-console' build
scripts.test:supabase-auth-compat: REQUIRE_SUPABASE_AUTH_COMPAT=1 RUN_SUPABASE_OAUTH21_COMPAT=1 RUN_SUPABASE_RUNTIME_COMPAT=1 RUN_SUPABASE_FULL_STACK_COMPAT=1 bun --use-system-ca test tests/integration/supabase-compat/oauth21.test.ts tests/integration/supabase-compat/supabase-js.test.ts tests/integration/supabase-compat/full-stack.test.ts tests/integration/supabase-compat/supacloud-js.test.ts
